abs_modulator.definition: The part of the brake that changes the brake pressure at a wheel when the system asks it to.
abs_modulator.example: The modulator holds the pressure at the wheel that is about to lock.

ecosystem.definition: The network of hardware, software, standards and services that a technology depends on to function.

hype_cycle.definition: The observed pattern in which new technologies pass through inflated expectations, disappointment, and eventual steady adoption.

si_figure.definition: An illustration, or a numerical value.
si_figure.example: Use this when the title names one figure.

udder.definition: The bag under a cow's body where the milk is made.
udder.example: The farmer washes the cow's udder before milking.
